vectors.claim: Large holders are accumulating UNI. No source, no figures. Resolve against a primary only: an on-chain flow with a named address, or an exchange or foundation report. A repeat across aggregators is not a quorum. Note that UNI already sits in AVOID for a structural reason - a high-beta name at the top of its range in risk-off - which is a statement about entry timing and does not contradict this claim; both can hold at once, and the run must not read one as refuting the other.

Candidate for the permanent universe. Deferred until the outside-list discovery channel is repaired: the argument for admission is the engine surfacing MORPHO on its own merits across several runs, not the owner naming it. Until then it is the position above and not a member of the universe. Do not treat this vector as an instruction to include it in the 28.
